design_overview: A modern, production-ready inventory management system designed for mobile-first interaction with clear visual hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and real-time data updates. The design prioritizes quick access to critical functions like barcode scanning, inventory tracking, and low stock alerts while maintaining a clean, professional aesthetic suitable for retail environments. The interface uses a card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, ensuring that primary actions are immediately accessible and secondary functions remain discoverable without cluttering the interface.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Dashboard Home
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing inventory overview, alerts, and quick actions for daily operations

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle bottom shadow, contains app title 'Inventory Manager' in bold text, notification bell icon on right
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to Alerts screen, shows red badge if unread alerts exist

key_components.name: Welcome Card
key_components.styling: Rounded corners, white surface, 16px padding, displays user role and current date
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive informational card

key_components.name: Quick Stats Grid
key_components.styling: Grid of 3 stat cards with rounded corners, light background, each showing metric title, large number, and trend indicator
key_components.interaction: Each stat card taps to navigate to detailed view (Total Products → Products screen, Low Stock → Alerts screen, Today's Sales → Reports screen)

key_components.name: Scan Barcode Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue background, white text, rounded corners, prominent size, centered icon and text 'Scan Product'
key_components.interaction: Opens camera for barcode scanning, navigates to Barcode Scanner screen

key_components.name: Recent Alerts Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Alerts' with 'View All' link, list of 3 alert items with warning icons, product names, and stock levels
key_components.interaction: Each alert item taps to navigate to Product Detail screen, 'View All' navigates to Alerts screen

key_components.name: Quick Actions Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, contains 2x2 grid of action buttons with icons and labels
key_components.interaction: Add Product → Product Management screen, Adjust Stock → Stock Adjustment modal, View Reports → Reports screen, Manage Users → Settings screen

key_components.name: Recent Transactions List
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Activity', scrollable list of 5 transaction items showing product name, type badge, quantity, and timestamp
key_components.interaction: Each transaction item taps to show transaction details modal

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, 5 evenly spaced navigation items with icons and labels, active item highlighted in primary blue
key_components.interaction: Navigates between main app sections: Home, Scan, Products, Reports, Settings

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login → Users can scan products, view alerts, check stats, or navigate to other sections via bottom nav

screens.name: Barcode Scanner
screens.purpose: Camera-based barcode scanning interface for quick product lookup and inventory updates

key_components.name: Scanner Header
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark overlay, white text 'Scan Barcode', back button on left
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to Dashboard Home

key_components.name: Camera Viewfinder
key_components.styling: Full-screen camera feed with centered scanning frame overlay, white corner brackets indicating scan area
key_components.interaction: Automatically scans barcodes when detected within frame

key_components.name: Scan Instructions
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent white card centered below scan frame, text 'Position barcode within frame'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive guidance text

key_components.name: Flash Toggle Button
key_components.styling: Circular button, semi-transparent white background, positioned top-right corner
key_components.interaction: Toggles camera flash on/off for low-light scanning

key_components.name: Manual Entry Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button, white background, primary blue text 'Enter Barcode Manually'
key_components.interaction: Opens modal with text input for manual barcode entry

key_components.name: Scan Result Card
key_components.styling: Slides up from bottom when barcode detected, white rounded card showing product image, name, price, current stock, and action buttons
key_components.interaction: Displays after successful scan, buttons for 'View Details', 'Update Stock', 'Close'

key_components.name: Error Message
key_components.styling: Red-tinted card with error icon, text 'Product not found', appears briefly when invalid barcode scanned
key_components.interaction: Auto-dismisses after 3 seconds or tap to dismiss

key_components.name: Scan History Button
key_components.styling: Text button, secondary color, 'Recent Scans' label
key_components.interaction: Opens bottom sheet showing last 10 scanned products

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Dashboard Home via Scan button or bottom nav → Scan barcode → View product details or update stock → Return to Dashboard or continue scanning

screens.name: Products List
screens.purpose: Comprehensive product catalog with search, filter, and management capabilities

key_components.name: Products Header
key_components.styling: White background, title 'Products', search icon right, filter icon right
key_components.interaction: Search icon opens search bar, filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Rounded input field, light gray background, search icon left, placeholder 'Search products...', clear button appears when typing
key_components.interaction: Real-time search filtering as user types, clear button removes search text

key_components.name: Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of filter chips: 'All', 'Low Stock', 'Categories', each with rounded borders
key_components.interaction: Tap chip to filter product list, active chip highlighted in primary color

key_components.name: Product Count Badge
key_components.styling: Small text badge showing '248 products' in secondary text color
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates based on active filters

key_components.name: Product List Items
key_components.styling: Scrollable list of product cards, each card shows product image thumbnail, name, barcode, price, stock quantity with color coding (green if sufficient, orange if low, red if critical)
key_components.interaction: Tap any product card to navigate to Product Detail screen

key_components.name: Low Stock Indicator
key_components.styling: Warning badge on product cards with stock below threshold, orange background, white text
key_components.interaction: Visual indicator only, tapping card navigates to details

key_components.name: Add Product FAB
key_components.styling: Floating action button, circular, primary blue background, white plus icon, positioned bottom-right with shadow
key_components.interaction: Opens Add New Product screen

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered card with illustration, text 'No products found', appears when search/filter returns no results
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive placeholder

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.styling: Small button with text 'Sort by: Name' and down arrow icon
key_components.interaction: Opens sort options menu: Name, Price, Stock Level, Recently Added

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, 5 navigation items, Products tab highlighted
key_components.interaction: Navigates between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed via bottom nav or Dashboard quick action → Browse/search products → Tap product for details → Edit or update stock → Return to list or navigate elsewhere

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed product information view with stock management and transaction history

key_components.name: Detail Header
key_components.styling: White background, back button left, product name as title, edit icon right, share icon right
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Products List, edit opens Edit Product screen, share opens share options

key_components.name: Product Image
key_components.styling: Large product image, rounded corners, centered, 16:9 aspect ratio, white background
key_components.interaction: Tap to view full-screen image gallery

key_components.name: Product Info Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, displays product name (large bold), barcode, category badge, description text
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive information display

key_components.name: Price and Stock Card
key_components.styling: White card, two-column layout showing Price (large bold) and Current Stock (large number with color coding), includes low stock threshold info
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, stock number color-coded based on threshold

key_components.name: Stock Alert Banner
key_components.styling: Warning banner with orange background if stock is low, includes warning icon and text 'Stock below threshold'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive alert indicator

key_components.name: Quick Actions Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row of 3 action buttons: 'Update Stock', 'Record Sale', 'Restock', each with icon and label
key_components.interaction: Update Stock opens stock adjustment modal, Record Sale opens sale entry modal, Restock opens restock modal

key_components.name: Transaction History Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Transactions', scrollable list of transaction items showing type badge, quantity, user, timestamp
key_components.interaction: Tap transaction to view full details in modal

key_components.name: Delete Product Button
key_components.styling: Text button in error red color, 'Delete Product' label, positioned at bottom
key_components.interaction: Opens confirmation dialog before deleting product

key_components.name: Stock Adjustment Modal
key_components.styling: Centered modal with white background, rounded corners, title 'Adjust Stock', input field for quantity, reason dropdown, save and cancel buttons
key_components.interaction: Input quantity change, select reason, save updates stock and creates transaction record

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Products List or Barcode Scanner → View product details → Perform stock actions → View transaction history → Return to previous screen or navigate elsewhere

screens.name: Sales Reports
screens.purpose: Analytics dashboard showing sales trends, top products, and revenue metrics with date filtering

key_components.name: Reports Header
key_components.styling: White background, title 'Sales Reports', filter icon right for date range selection
key_components.interaction: Filter icon opens date range picker modal

key_components.name: Date Range Selector
key_components.styling: Horizontal chip group with preset ranges: 'Today', 'Week', 'Month', 'Custom', active chip highlighted
key_components.interaction: Tap chip to change report period, 'Custom' opens date picker

key_components.name: Revenue Summary Card
key_components.styling: Prominent card with gradient background (subtle), large revenue number, percentage change indicator with up/down arrow, comparison text 'vs previous period'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive summary display

key_components.name: Key Metrics Grid
key_components.styling: 2x2 grid of metric cards showing Total Sales, Items Sold, Average Transaction, Top Category, each with icon and trend indicator
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive metrics display

key_components.name: Sales Chart
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, section header 'Sales Trend', line/bar chart visualization showing sales over time period
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive chart visualization, may support pinch-zoom on mobile

key_components.name: Top Products List
key_components.styling: Section header 'Top Selling Products', ranked list of product cards with rank number, product image, name, units sold, revenue
key_components.interaction: Tap product to navigate to Product Detail screen

key_components.name: Category Breakdown Card
key_components.styling: White card, section header 'Sales by Category', horizontal bar chart or list showing category names and sales percentages
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive category breakdown

key_components.name: Export Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button, outlined style, 'Export Report' label with share icon
key_components.interaction: Opens export options: PDF, CSV, Email

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Reports tab highlighted
key_components.interaction: Navigates between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed via bottom nav or Dashboard quick action → Select date range → View sales metrics and charts → Explore top products → Export report if needed → Navigate to other sections

screens.name: Alerts & Notifications
screens.purpose: Centralized view of all low stock alerts and system notifications with management options

key_components.name: Alerts Header
key_components.styling: White background, title 'Alerts', settings icon right for notification preferences
key_components.interaction: Settings icon opens notification settings modal

key_components.name: Alert Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Horizontal tab bar with 'All', 'Unread', 'Low Stock', 'Critical', active tab underlined in primary color
key_components.interaction: Tap tab to filter alert list

key_components.name: Mark All Read Button
key_components.styling: Text button, secondary color, 'Mark all as read' label, positioned top-right
key_components.interaction: Marks all visible alerts as read, updates unread count

key_components.name: Alert Count Badge
key_components.styling: Small badge showing number of unread alerts, orange background if any unread
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive count display

key_components.name: Alert List Items
key_components.styling: Scrollable list of alert cards, each showing alert icon (color-coded by severity), product name, stock level, threshold, timestamp, unread alerts have blue left border
key_components.interaction: Tap alert to mark as read and navigate to Product Detail screen, swipe left reveals 'Delete' action

key_components.name: Critical Alert Banner
key_components.styling: Red-tinted card for critical alerts (stock at 0), prominent warning icon, bold text
key_components.interaction: Tap to view product details and restock options

key_components.name: Alert Actions
key_components.styling: Action buttons within each alert card: 'Restock', 'View Product', 'Dismiss'
key_components.interaction: Restock opens restock modal, View Product navigates to detail, Dismiss marks as read and removes from list

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered card with success icon, text 'No alerts - all stock levels are healthy', appears when no alerts exist
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive placeholder

key_components.name: Notification Settings Modal
key_components.styling: Modal with title 'Notification Settings', toggle switches for alert types, threshold adjustment inputs, save button
key_components.interaction: Configure which alerts to receive and at what thresholds, save updates user preferences

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, Home tab highlighted when accessed from dashboard
key_components.interaction: Navigates between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed via Dashboard alert section, notification bell, or direct navigation → Filter alerts by type → View alert details → Take action (restock, view product, dismiss) → Configure notification settings if needed → Return to Dashboard or navigate elsewhere

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Cards and lists use flexible layouts that adapt to screen width. Bottom navigation remains fixed and accessible on all screens. Modals and bottom sheets use full-width on mobile. Typography scales proportionally. Images use responsive aspect ratios. Horizontal scrolling used sparingly for filter chips and quick actions. Web version uses same components in wider container (max 1200px) with side margins, bottom nav converts to side navigation on tablet/desktop.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI components. Icons paired with text labels for clarity. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholders. Error states communicated through color, icons, and text. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported on web version. Focus states clearly visible with primary blue outline. Alert notifications include both visual and text indicators. All images include alt text descriptions.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (left/right for navigation, up for modals). Button presses show 100ms scale feedback (0.95 scale). List items fade in with 200ms stagger on load. Bottom sheets slide up with spring animation. Loading states use subtle pulse animation on skeleton screens. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. Error states shake horizontally. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform animations. Chart data animates in with 500ms ease. All animations respect user's reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for inactive states and filled style for active states. Icons sourced from standard system icon libraries (SF Symbols for iOS, Material Icons for Android). Primary icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (bookmark outline), heart (heart outline), filter (funnel), plus (plus sign), edit (pencil), trash (trash bin), share (share arrow). Icons sized at 24x24px for navigation, 20x20px for buttons, 16x16px for inline use. Color matches text color in context (primary blue for active, secondary gray for inactive, white on colored backgrounds).
